decision_conditions: The existing development constitutes Lawful Development under Section 191 of Town and Country Planning Act 1990, Section 191 as amended by Section 10 of the Planning and Compensation Act 1991, as the Applicant has sufficiently demonstrated that, on the balance of probability, the conversion of the property from a dwelling (Use Class C3) to a small HMO (Use Class C4) occurred prior to 11.12.2025 - the date that the Council's immediate Article 4 Direction to remove Permitted Development rights borough-wide for such conversions came into effect.

Weighing all available evidence, it is considered that on the balance of probabilities, the conversion of the application property from C3 to its current C4 Use likely took place before 11.12.2025.
